entry.title: Hello
entry.content: This is the first post on my new site. I plan to use this space for shorter pieces that do not fit in a paper: notes on small-angle scattering and data reduction, ionic liquids and deep eutectic solvents, the software I work on, and the odd opinion.
entry.summary: A first post, and what this blog is for.
